stories.headline: US escalates sanctions on Iran, targets ‘shadow banking’ networks
stories.description: US Treasury sanctions over two dozen Iranian entities, citing efforts to disrupt Tehran’s global financial activities.

stories.headline: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
stories.description: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

stories.headline: Protesting Bangladesh garment workers reject pay offer
stories.description: Bangladesh’s garment industry brings in about $38bn a year. The minimum wage is around 12,500 taka ($100) per month.

stories.headline: Andrew received £750,000 from Turkish millionaire, court told
stories.description: The former Duke of York is expected to give evidence in the complex court case next month.

stories.headline: Russia threatens ‘hostile’ Estonia with ‘open war’
stories.description: Moscow accuses Tallinn of ‘hostile actions’ citing border closure and claiming it is allowing Ukraine to launch attacks.
